question: In which of the following months did the institutes of Department of Science and Technology (DST) and the Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO) join hands to strengthen ground-based Space Situational Awareness?
solution:
The correct answer is __**May 2025**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Department of Science and Technology (DST)** and the **Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO)** collaborated in **May 2025** to strengthen **ground-based Space Situational Awareness (SSA).**
 
• This collaboration focuses on enhancing **India's capacity to monitor and track space objects, including satellites and space debris**, in order to ensure the safety of space assets.
 
• The initiative is critical to the development of **indigenous SSA capabilities**, reducing dependence on international systems for space monitoring.
 
• SSA has become increasingly important in the context of growing space activity, including launches, satellite operations, and the management of space debris.
